headline: Solar Desalination Brings 7.5M Litres of Water to Remote Aboriginal School
meta_description: A solar-powered desalination unit has delivered over 7.5 million litres of water to an off-grid Aboriginal boarding school in Western Australia.
summary_short: An off-grid Aboriginal boarding school in Western Australia now has a reliable water supply thanks to a solar-powered desalination unit that has produced 7.5 million lit…
body:
A solar-powered desalination unit has supplied over 7.5 million litres of water to an off-grid Aboriginal boarding school in Western Australia, addressing a critical infrastructure challenge in remote Australia.

The installation represents more than just a water solution—it has become an educational opportunity. Students at the school have been actively involved in installing and maintaining the system, gaining hands-on experience with renewable energy technology and sustainable water management.

The project demonstrates how off-grid communities can harness solar power to solve pressing resource challenges while simultaneously empowering the next generation with practical skills in clean technology.
